kv7.1:1.1: natthī keci dhammā kehici dhammehi saṅgahitā’ti.
kv7.1:1.3: nanu atthī keci dhammā kehici dhammehi gaṇanaṃ gacchanti, uddesaṃ gacchanti. pariyāpannā’ti.
kv7.1:1.5: hañci atthī keci dhammā kehici dhammehi gaṇanaṃ gacchanti, uddesaṃ gacchanti pariyāpannā, anu pā: no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:1.6: natthī keci dhammā kehici dhammehi saṅgahitā’ti.
kv7.1:2.3: hañci cakkhāyatanaṃ rūpakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, anu pā: tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:2.10: hañci kāyāyatanaṃ rūpakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:3.7: hañci phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ rūpakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, anu pā: tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:4.3: hañci sukhā vedanā vedanākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, anu pā: tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:4.5: dukkhā vedanā …pe… adukkhamasukhā vedanā katamaṃ khandhagaṇanaṃ gacchatī’ti.
kv7.1:4.7: hañci adukkhamasukhā vedanā vedanākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:5.3: hañci cakkhusamphassajā saññā saññākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, anu pā: tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:5.8: hañci manosamphassajā saññā saññākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:6.4: hañci manosamphassajā cetanā saṅkhārakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:7.4: hañci manoviññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv7.1:8.1: yathā dāmena vā yottena vā dve balivaddā saṅgahitā, sikkāya piṇḍapāto saṅgahito, sā gaddulena saṅgahito
kv7.1:8.2: evameva te dhammā tehi dhammehi saṅgahitā’ti.
